office_does: The coroner investigates unnatural, violent or suspicious deaths in Benton County and can hold inquests.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent William "Bill" Leach (Prefers Republican Party), coroner for two terms, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Benton County Coroner for two terms; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Coroner for two terms; re-elected unopposed in 2022 [S1][S3]
Hired a staff forensic pathologist and contracts autopsies to other counties to offset costs [S1]
